partner.descriptionHtml:
Note: Payment via Kris+ directly on Golden Village website and theatres is not available. Earn or redeem your miles on Golden Village via purchase of Golden Village movie e-Vouchers code only.

Golden Village is Singapore's leading cinema exhibitor with 16 multiplexes and 125 screens.

Golden Village movie e-Vouchers code can be purchased for redemption via Golden Village’s website and iGV app. Booking fees apply.


Terms & Conditions:

  • Valid for all days & sessions (excluding Christmas & Christmas Eve, New Year’s Eve, New Year's Day, Lunar New Year Eve & first 2 days of Lunar New Year).
  • Valid only for regular 2D movies, formats, seats.
  • Not valid for Gold Class Cinemas, premium-priced movies, seats, tickets, formats, group bookings, special events and movies restricted by the distributor. Premium-priced films, content or products are Gold Class®, films in GVmax® Dolby Atmos®, Gemini at GV City Square & GV Funan, Deluxe Plus at GV Funan, Duo Deluxe at GV Paya Lebar, concert films, special premieres, film festivals, movies marked with “Premium” tag, special themed event movies and as otherwise stated in Golden Village T&Cs.
  • Valid for online bookings only where booking fee applies. Not valid for Automated Ticketing Machines, Telephone and over-the-counter bookings.
  • Maximum of 4 movie e-Voucher codes can be redeemed per transaction.
  • All movie e-Voucher codes are one-time-use only.
  • e-Voucher is strictly non-refundable, not redeemable for cash and not for resale.
  • Golden Village will not accept expired e-Vouchers & will not entertain revalidation requests.

 

How to redeem:

  • After e-Voucher purchase is successful, a unique promo code will be saved in your "Promo Codes" wallet.
  • Copy the promo code and head to https://www.gv.com.sg/ or the iGV app to choose your movie, movie timings and seats.
  • Choose the Ticket Price “Movie e-Voucher”.
  • Choose the Payment Method, “Payment via Credit Card with Movie e-Voucher Code”.
  • Fill in your particulars, then click “Next”.
  • Fill in the e-Voucher code in the “Movie e-Voucher” field and fill in your Credit/Debit card information.
  • The summary page will show the payment information. Please key in the OTP in the Bank OTP site to finalise payment.
  • Your booking has been confirmed when you receive a GV QR code.
